How to use Keystone

For homeowners who want to know what is in their house, what it needs and what it will cost, and for the contractors who do the work.

Open Keystone ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to keystone-home-five.vercel.app.

2

Click Explore a demo home to see a house already filled in, or Start free to create your account.

3

Answer the four onboarding steps: the house, its systems, the shutoffs, the summary.

4

Open Property to check the age of each system, then Plan ahead for the 10-year plan.

5

Open Upkeep and mark the first tasks done.

6

When something goes wrong, open Diagnose, answer the questions, then request a pro.

02

Features

01

Home and Home Health

The home page shows a health score out of 100 with its three biggest reasons, the tasks that need attention with a one-tap Done, the plan and the open requests. The Home Health Snapshot asks 15 questions about the house; each finding can become a task.

STEPS

  1. Open Home Health
  2. Answer the 15 questions
  3. Add a finding to the plan
02

Systems and life stage

Each of the 75 component types has a typical life and a replacement cost. A system page shows its age, its stage from New to Past typical life, the year to plan for, its records, documents and maintenance, and an equipment card to send to a pro.

STEPS

  1. Open Property
  2. Pick a system
  3. Edit details or log work
03

The 10-year capital plan

Replacements year by year with 3 percent inflation, the reserve you have, the monthly amount that keeps you on time and a preparedness score. Items already past their typical life are spread over three years, worst condition first, and what-if controls move any item to the year you expect.

STEPS

  1. Open Plan ahead
  2. Enter your reserve
  3. Move an item with what-if
04

Maintenance calendar

Tasks built from your systems, such as filters, smoke alarm tests, the dryer vent and gutters, each with its time, DIY or pro, and season. Mark done writes the work into the history; Add to my calendar downloads a calendar file.

STEPS

  1. Open Upkeep
  2. Mark a task done
  3. Add to my calendar
05

Diagnose and requests

36 common problems in five groups. A safety question comes first, then a few questions, then the likely cause, how urgent it is, a fair price range and the steps you can do yourself. One button sends a request with the details to pros who serve your ZIP code; quotes, messages, the visit and a review follow on the same page.

STEPS

  1. Open Diagnose
  2. Answer the questions
  3. Request a pro
06

Keystone Pro

For contractors: a written day briefing with the route and what to bring, requests by trade and ZIP code, quotes with the member discount, a week schedule, a job record with before and after photos and notes, estimates and invoices with a link the customer can open. Pros never pay to rank.

STEPS

  1. Open Today
  2. Quote a request
  3. Finish the job and send the invoice
07

The book

Inside Your House, 24 chapters and 63 drawings, read online in the app for 25 dollars, with the preface and chapter 1 free, adjustable text size and a night mode. Each chapter ends with a checklist and links to the matching page of Keystone Home.

STEPS

  1. Read chapter 1 free
  2. Buy the book, 25 dollars
  3. Tick the checklist
03Tips
  • Start with the demo home to see every page filled in, then create your own house.
  • Copy the install year from the label on each appliance: the plan is only as good as those years.
  • Before you call a pro, run Diagnose: the request then carries the answers, the system's age and its history.
04FAQ
Is it free?

Yes for one home: every system, the plan, the calendar, Diagnose and a free sample of the book. The full book is 25 dollars. Plus, at 8 dollars a month or 79 a year, adds unlimited homes, the document vault, the inventory and the reports. Care, at 19 dollars a month, adds the concierge.

Who sees my house?

Only you. A pro sees a request only for their trade and area, with your first name and city until you book them.

Are the prices exact?

No. Lifespans and costs are national planning estimates; local prices vary.

How do contractors join?

Keystone Pro starts with a 15-day free trial, then Solo at 29 dollars or Team at 79 dollars a month.

Which language?

English, for houses in the United States.
